signal: Dominion DMS launched Dominion VUE, a cloud-based dealer management system on Microsoft Azure with a STAR-compliant API

email.subject1: a signal play for Dominion DMS
email.body1:
Mike, saw Dominion DMS launch VUE, the cloud-based DMS on Azure with the STAR-compliant API.

A platform launch puts a lot of dealers in-market at once, usually more than the field team can cover before the window closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dominion off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mike, quick follow-up for Dominion DMS.

A new cloud DMS opens conversations across your whole dealer base, but most teams can't tell how many of those accounts they're actually touching, so the launch converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to turn VUE momentum into target this quarter.
email.body3:
Mike, last bit of proof for Dominion.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your region's reply rate likely compares to peer dealer-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mike, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling dealer pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a new cloud platform is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a dealer-tech motion? I'll tailor it to Dominion either way.
